parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more deeply personalized rationales citing multiple specific profile attributes (variable consultant income, legacy goal, loss comfort, horizon) with concrete tickers, allocations, and first-step instructions across all four recs. System B is competent and adds useful tax-optimization angle, but its rationales are less specific, one rec has 'N/A' tickers, and its Rec #3 mischaracterizes sector weights (industrials/financials at 15% each) as if uncontested while the actionability is weaker.
